package.name: ral_eval
package.description: Evaluation-side nodes and helpers: they observe the robot, they never drive it. ground_truth_node republishes simulator ground truth on an evaluation-only topic and deliberately broadcasts no TF, so no localization or navigation component can consume truth by accident. capture_world_to_map measures the gz world -> SLAM map alignment once per map, and frames.py is the single implementation of that conversion, shared by the nav launch file and the Phase 3 metrics.
